calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the multi-tenant house specific use regulations of Section 150.25 for the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Multi-tenant house is not a MaxBLD building type or vocab use; the included Section 150.25 is not evaluated here.

units.disclosure: A multi-tenant house in the R zone must also meet the specific use rules in Section 150.25; we do not evaluate multi-tenant houses.

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the secondary suite specific use regulations of Section 150.10 for the R zone; the included section's own units carry any evaluation.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only when a secondary suite is proposed (user input has_secondary_suite).

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the seniors community house specific use regulations of Section 150.30 for the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Seniors community house is not a MaxBLD building type or vocab use.

units.disclosure: A seniors community house in the R zone must also meet the specific use rules in Section 150.30; we do not evaluate this use.

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the short-term rental specific use regulations of Section 150.13 for the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Short-term rental is a use outside the MaxBLD building-envelope scope and not in vocab.uses.

units.disclosure: A short-term rental in the R zone must also meet the specific use rules in Section 150.13; we do not evaluate short-term rentals.

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the laneway suite specific use regulations of Section 150.8 for the R zone; the included section's own units carry any evaluation.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only when a laneway suite is proposed (user input has_laneway_suite).

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the garden suite specific use regulations of Section 150.7 for the R zone; the included section's own units carry any evaluation.
calculation_handling.gaps: Applies only when a garden suite is proposed (user input has_garden_suite).

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the day nursery specific use regulations of Section 150.45 for the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Day nursery is a non-residential use outside MaxBLD scope.

units.disclosure: A day nursery in the R zone must also meet the specific use rules in Section 150.45; we do not evaluate this use.

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the group home specific use regulations of Section 150.15 for the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Group home is not a MaxBLD building type or vocab use.

units.disclosure: A group home in the R zone must also meet the specific use rules in Section 150.15; we do not evaluate this use.

calculation_handling.description: Incorporates the place of worship specific use regulations of Section 150.50 for the R zone.
calculation_handling.gaps: Place of worship is a non-residential use outside MaxBLD scope.

units.disclosure: A place of worship in the R zone must also meet the specific use rules in Section 150.50; we do not evaluate this use.

calculation_handling.description: A place of worship in the R zone must be on a lot with a lot frontage of at least 30 metres.
calculation_handling.gaps: The limit applies only to a place of worship, which is not a MaxBLD building type or vocab use, so it is keyed with building_types any and not modelled; it must not be applied to residential building types.

units.disclosure: A place of worship in the R zone needs a lot frontage of at least 30 metres; this does not affect houses and is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: A place of worship in the R zone must be in a building that is or was originally constructed as a place of worship.
calculation_handling.gaps: Non-numeric obligation with no matching vocab.requirement token; concerns a non-residential use outside MaxBLD scope.

units.disclosure: A place of worship in the R zone must be in a building originally constructed as a place of worship; not evaluated.

10.10.20.100(13).explanation: A multi-tenant house in the R zone must also follow the specific rules in Section 150.25. MaxBLD does not evaluate multi-tenant houses.

10.10.20.100(14).explanation: A secondary suite in the R zone must follow the secondary suite rules in Section 150.10, which are explained under that section.

10.10.20.100(15).explanation: A seniors community house in the R zone must also follow the specific rules in Section 150.30. MaxBLD does not evaluate this use.

10.10.20.100(18).explanation: A short-term rental in the R zone must also follow the specific rules in Section 150.13. MaxBLD does not evaluate short-term rentals.

10.10.20.100(19).explanation: A laneway suite in the R zone must follow the laneway suite rules in Section 150.8, which are explained under that section.

10.10.20.100(20).explanation: A garden suite in the R zone must follow the garden suite rules in Section 150.7, which are explained under that section.

10.10.20.100(4).explanation: A day nursery in the R zone must also follow the specific rules in Section 150.45. MaxBLD does not evaluate this use.

10.10.20.100(5).explanation: A group home in the R zone must also follow the specific rules in Section 150.15. MaxBLD does not evaluate this use.
